business.description: Trailhead home page headed Take the scenic route, introducing guided outdoor adventures.
rules: The visitor can browse adventures or begin planning a trip.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Adventure catalogue headed Find your next adventure, offering Ridge walk and River paddle.
rules: Ridge walk is advertised at AUD 80 per traveller.
River paddle is advertised at AUD 120 per traveller.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Ridge walk information page headed Ridge walk: above it all.
rules: The walk lasts four hours.
Walking poles and a shared picnic are included.
The visitor can begin planning an adventure.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: River paddle information page headed River paddle: go with the flow.
rules: The paddle lasts three hours.
Kayak, paddle and life jacket are included.
The visitor can begin planning an adventure.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Equipment guide headed Pack light. We have the rest.
rules: Walking poles are included for Ridge walk.
Kayak, paddle and life jacket are included for River paddle.
The visitor can open information about either adventure.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Booking policy page headed Clear plans. Fair policies.
rules: Reviewing an adventure does not reserve places.
Final cancellation gives a full refund including the conservation gift.
Each booking receives one refund only.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Help page headed A little help before you go, with contact and trip guidance.
rules: The contact address is hello@trailhead.example.test.
The visitor can open the equipment guide or refund policy.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Member account page headed Your Trailhead account, displaying stored contact details and preferences.
rules: The member can begin editing their profile.
Supported update preferences are described as Email, SMS and None.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Adventure planning form headed Plan your adventure, with City visitor centre selected as departure pickup and no validation errors.
rules: The selected departure pickup is City visitor centre.
A lead traveller name entry field is available.
A contact email entry field is available.
A party size entry field is available.
An adventure choice entry field is available.
A conservation gift entry field is available.
The traveller can choose a different departure pickup point.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Adventure planning form headed Plan your adventure, with Marina pier selected as departure pickup and no validation errors.
rules: The selected departure pickup is Marina pier.
A lead traveller name entry field is available.
A contact email entry field is available.
A party size entry field is available.
An adventure choice entry field is available.
A conservation gift entry field is available.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Adventure entry form headed Booking details need attention, displaying field validation explanations.
rules: A booking validation error is visible.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Draft adventure summary headed Review your adventure, awaiting final confirmation.
rules: The displayed traveller name equals the submitted traveller name after trimming surrounding spaces.
The displayed contact email equals the submitted contact email after trimming surrounding spaces.
The displayed party size equals the submitted party size.
The displayed adventure equals the submitted adventure.
The displayed conservation contribution equals the submitted conservation contribution as a numeric amount.
The displayed unit price is AUD 80 for Ridge walk or AUD 120 for River paddle.
The trip subtotal equals the submitted party size multiplied by the displayed unit price.
The conservation gift amount equals the submitted conservation contribution rounded to the nearest cent.
The party total equals the displayed trip subtotal plus the displayed conservation gift amount.
The review is explicitly a draft with no places reserved.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Completed adventure confirmation headed Adventure booked, showing a booking reference and reserved places.
rules: A booking reference is displayed.
The booking is explicitly confirmed with places reserved.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Member profile entry form headed Edit your member profile, without validation errors.
rules: A display name entry field is available.
A member email entry field is available.
An updates preference entry field is available.
An optional accessibility notes entry field is available.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Member profile form headed Profile details need attention, showing field validation explanations.
rules: A member profile validation error is visible.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Profile save acknowledgement headed Member profile saved, displaying persisted member values.
rules: The displayed display name equals the submitted display name after trimming surrounding spaces.
The displayed member email equals the submitted member email after trimming surrounding spaces.
The displayed updates preference equals the submitted updates preference.
The profile is explicitly acknowledged as saved.
The displayed accessibility notes equal the submitted access notes after trimming spaces, with a blank notes value displayed as None.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Cancellation request form headed Request a cancellation, showing the existing booking reference and proposed full refund.
rules: A cancellation reason can be supplied.
The proposed full refund is displayed.
The traveller can keep the existing booking.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Cancellation form headed Cancellation reason needs attention, showing a reason validation explanation.
rules: A cancellation reason validation error is visible.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Cancellation preview headed Review your cancellation, awaiting final cancellation and refund.
rules: The displayed cancellation reason equals the submitted cancellation reason after trimming surrounding spaces.
The booking is explicitly still confirmed.
No refund has been issued at this stage.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.description: Cancellation acknowledgement headed Booking cancelled and refunded, confirming released places and the issued full refund.
rules: The booking is explicitly cancelled.
The reserved places are explicitly released.
The full refund is acknowledged as issued.
The displayed cancellation reason equals the submitted cancellation reason after trimming surrounding spaces.
The main navigation offers Home, Adventures, Equipment, My account and Help.

business.purpose: Explore guided adventures, manage member details, validate party inputs, reserve places only at final confirmation, and cancel with a full refund.
rules: Invalid adventure booking details are rejected with explanations identifying the affected fields.
Invalid member profile details are rejected with explanations identifying the affected fields.
Invalid cancellation reasons are rejected with an explanation identifying the problem.
The main navigation remains available throughout every activity.
Adventure prices are AUD 80 per traveller for Ridge walk and AUD 120 per traveller for River paddle.

Contact email.description: Email address for the adventure booking

Party size.description: How many travellers are included in this booking

Adventure.description: Which guided trip the party is booking

Conservation contribution.description: An additional gift in AUD, added once to the whole booking

Display name.description: The name displayed on the member account

Member email.description: Email address stored on the member account

Access notes.description: Optional accessibility requirements for the member

Cancellation reason.description: Why the traveller is cancelling the existing booking
